ewaste_bulk.label: Bulk consumer of electrical & electronic equipment

fire_noc_required.label: Premises needs Fire NOC (height ≥ 15 m, hospital, factory, assembly)

electrical_contractor.label: Business holds an electrical contractor licence

obligations.title: EPF monthly ECR & contribution payment
inputs: Monthly payroll: gross, basic+DA, PF wages per employee
obligations.penalty: Interest + damages on delayed remittance; prosecution for deducted-but-not-paid
obligations.audit_point: Recompute 2 months of PF on wages per Code on Wages 2(y) 50% rule; tie TRRN to bank

obligations.title: ESI monthly contribution
obligations.penalty: Interest + damages; loss of benefits to employees
obligations.audit_point: Check all employees ≤ wage ceiling are covered; joiners registered within 10 days

obligations.title: Register new joiners (UAN / ESI IP) and issue appointment letter
obligations.law: OSH Code 2020 s.6(1)(f); Code on Social Security
obligations.due: Within 10 days of joining (ESI); appointment letter at joining

obligations.title: Pay monthly wages by the statutory date
obligations.penalty: Fine up to ₹50,000 (first offence), higher for repeat
obligations.audit_point: Sample 3 months: payment date ≤ 7th; wage slips issued

obligations.title: Full & final settlement within 2 working days of exit
obligations.due: 2 working days from removal / dismissal / resignation

obligations.title: Minimum wage / VDA revision check
obligations.law: Code on Wages, 2019; state minimum wage notifications
obligations.due: On each VDA revision (MH: Jan & Jul)
inputs: Current wage master by skill category

obligations.title: Statutory bonus payment
obligations.due: Within 8 months of close of accounting year (30 Nov)

obligations.title: Maintain registers (employees, wages, attendance, OT, deductions)
obligations.audit_point: Inspect registers for 2 sampled months; cross-check with payroll

obligations.title: Annual return under labour codes
obligations.law: Labour codes — central/state rules (single electronic return)
inputs: Annual headcount, wages, leave, accidents, bonus data

obligations.title: Registration of establishment (OSH Code)
obligations.due: Before / on applicability; update changes within prescribed time
inputs: Establishment details, employer, nature of work, headcount incl. contract

obligations.title: Factory licence (OSH Code) — renewal
inputs: Licence details, max workers, power (HP/kW), plans if changed
obligations.penalty: Running an unlicensed factory — penalty and prosecution
obligations.audit_point: Actual headcount and power vs licensed limits

obligations.title: Annual free health check-up (employees above prescribed age)
inputs: List of employees above prescribed age

obligations.title: Principal employer: verify contractors' licence, wages, PF & ESI monthly
obligations.law: OSH Code, 2020 Ch. XI (contract labour); Code on Wages (principal employer liability)
obligations.penalty: Principal employer liable for unpaid wages/contributions of contract workers
obligations.audit_point: Gate attendance vs ECR member count, 2 contractors × 2 months

obligations.title: POSH: Internal Committee constituted & policy displayed
obligations.penalty: Fine up to ₹50,000; licence cancellation on repeat

obligations.title: POSH annual report (IC → employer → District Officer)
obligations.law: POSH Act, 2013 s.21; POSH Rules r.14
obligations.due: Calendar year report — typically by 31 Jan (state practice)

obligations.title: Statutory notices & abstracts displayed (bilingual)
obligations.law: Labour codes + rules (wages, hours, holidays, safety, POSH)
inputs: Current wage rates, shift timings, holiday list, IC details

obligations.title: Maharashtra Labour Welfare Fund contribution
obligations.due: June & December contributions by 15 Jul / 15 Jan
inputs: Employees on roll on 30 Jun / 31 Dec

obligations.title: Professional Tax (PTRC) — deduct, pay & return
obligations.law: Maharashtra State Tax on Professions, Trades, Callings and Employments Act, 1975
obligations.due: Last day of month (monthly if previous-year liability ≥ ₹50,000; else annual by 31 Mar)

obligations.title: Shops & Establishments registration / intimation
obligations.law: Maharashtra Shops and Establishments (Regulation of Employment and Conditions of Service) Act, 2017
obligations.due: Registration (≥10 workers) or intimation (<10); changes within prescribed time

obligations.title: TDS deposit
inputs: TDS deducted by section (salary, contractors, rent, professional)
obligations.penalty: Interest per month of delay; disallowance of expense

obligations.title: Quarterly TDS statements
obligations.law: Income-tax Act, 2025 — new form numbers under Income-tax Rules, 2026
obligations.penalty: Late fee per day + penalty for non-filing

obligations.title: GSTR-1 (monthly)
obligations.penalty: Late fee per day; blocks e-way bill / ITC for buyers

obligations.title: GSTR-3B (monthly) & tax payment
inputs: Output tax, ITC per GSTR-2B reconciliation

obligations.title: GST QRMP: PMT-06 monthly, GSTR-1 & 3B quarterly
obligations.due: PMT-06 by 25th; GSTR-1 by 13th and 3B by 22nd/24th after quarter

obligations.title: Income-tax return & tax audit report
obligations.due: Audit report 30 Sep; return 31 Oct (audit cases)

obligations.title: Annual General Meeting
obligations.due: Within 6 months of FY end (30 Sep)

obligations.title: MSME-1 half-yearly return (dues to MSEs > 45 days)
LLP Form 11 (30 May) & Form 8 (30 Oct)
obligations.due: Form 11 by 30 May; Form 8 by 30 Oct

obligations.title: Pay Micro/Small suppliers within 45 days
obligations.law: MSMED Act, 2006 s.15; Income-tax disallowance for delayed MSE payments
inputs: Payables ageing with supplier Udyam status

obligations.title: Consent to Operate (Water & Air Acts) — renewal
obligations.law: Water Act 1974 s.25; Air Act 1981 s.21
obligations.due: Apply well before expiry (lead time 120 days)
inputs: Production/capacity, water consumption, effluent & emission data
obligations.audit_point: Walk CTO conditions one by one with evidence

obligations.title: Environmental Statement (Form V)
inputs: Water, raw-material, waste and emission data for the FY

obligations.title: Stack / effluent / ambient monitoring by recognised lab
Hazardous waste: authorisation, 90-day storage, manifests, annual return (Form 4)
obligations.due: Annual return by 30 June; manifest per consignment

obligations.title: Plastic packaging EPR (PIBO): registration & annual return
E-waste: channelise to registered recyclers; keep records
DG set emission & noise compliance
obligations.law: Environment (Protection) Rules — DG set norms; CTO

obligations.title: Fire: Form B (half-yearly certificate by licensed agency)
obligations.law: Maharashtra Fire Prevention and Life Safety Measures Act, 2006

obligations.title: Fire & evacuation drills; fire-fighting training
obligations.law: National Building Code 2016 Part 4; state fire rules

obligations.title: Lift licence / periodic inspection
obligations.law: Maharashtra Lifts, Escalators and Moving Walks Act, 2017

obligations.title: Electrical installation: periodic inspection / self-certification
obligations.law: CEA (Measures relating to Safety and Electric Supply) Regulations, 2023

obligations.title: Earthing, IR & protection tests with records
inputs: Test readings by licensed electrical contractor

obligations.title: Report electrical accident to Electrical Inspector
Supervisor / wireman competency certificates valid on every job
Pressure vessels / air receivers — periodic examination
obligations.law: OSH Code state rules; SMPV(U) Rules 2016 where applicable

obligations.title: Lifting machines & tackles — examination by competent person
Weighing & measuring instruments — verification & stamping
obligations.law: Legal Metrology Act 2009; state enforcement rules

obligations.title: Nursing home registration — renewal
obligations.law: Maharashtra Nursing Homes Registration Act, 1949 (as amended) & rules

obligations.title: Display of rates & patient rights charter
obligations.law: Maharashtra Nursing Homes rules (as amended) / Clinical Establishments standards

obligations.title: BMW monthly record on website; daily register; bar-coded bags
PC-PNDT monthly report & Form F completeness
obligations.audit_point: Sample Form F: 100% fields complete, declarations signed

obligations.title: Drug licence (retail) — validity, pharmacist, Schedule H1 register
NDPS: recognised medical institution, stock registers
Biomedical equipment calibration & preventive maintenance
inputs: Asset register with calibration due dates

obligations.title: Registration of establishment for building / construction work
obligations.law: OSH Code, 2020 (building or other construction work)

obligations.title: Building & other construction workers cess (1% of cost)
obligations.penalty: Interest and penalty on unpaid cess

obligations.title: Site safety: daily checklist, scaffolding/lifting inspection, PPE, welfare
obligations.law: OSH Code, 2020 + building work rules; NBC Part 7

obligations.title: RERA annual audited statement of project account (Form 5)
DPDP: notices, consent, rights, retention, breach response (full compliance by 13-May-2027)
obligations.law: Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 & DPDP Rules, 2025
obligations.penalty: Penalties up to ₹250 crore per breach category

obligations.title: Personal data breach intimation to Board & affected persons
obligations.due: Without delay; detailed report within prescribed time (verify)
